subjects.description: The set of subject ids that this batch will pack

strategyId.description: The strategy id of for the {@link Feature} or {@link Feature.Set} used for this pack job

bin.description: The bin number of the bin where all the blocks in this batch are grouped

featureFingerprint.description: The featureFingerprint of the {@link Feature} or {@link Feature.Set} used for this pack job

tableName.description: The table name of the new packed blocks

blocks.description:
The blocks to be packed. These blocks will eventually form a "rectangle", which means that all the subjects in each block
should have the same timeRange after this function call, i.e. there won't be any missing timeRange gaps or extra timeRanges.

title: This type contains the information that is needed to pack a batch of {@link Feature.Store.Block}s into one single block.
name: Feature.Store.Block.PackBatch
